_comment: Skills, using the schema from brief section 37. The prologue needs exactly
one, and that is on purpose: Spark alone teaches ranged magic, MP cost and
elemental identity without a menu the player has to read.

skills.name: Spark
skills.description: A short, loud bolt. Maeve is proud of it.
skills.notes: Damage is power + magic - resistance, per brief section 28's formula. Power 6 plus Maeve's magic 4 plus her staff's +2 minus a Goblin Raider's resistance 1 is 11 against 12 HP: two casts, matching Rowan's two hits. Brief section 60 wants the VFX simple but punchy; the script says the same.
